import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    r0, r1, K, a, b = params[0], params[1], params[2], params[3], params[4]
    return (r0 + r1*t)*P*(1-P/K) - a/P + b*t

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t) + (p[2] + p[3]*t)*P + (p[4] + p[5]*t)*P**2 + p[6]/P + p[7]*t/P
